title_he: אֵיךְ, וְאַתָּה הַדּוֹד, יֶאֱהַב לִבִּי זוּלָתְךָ
review: The hymn is a threefold 'how could I love another': 1:1–4 is Jer 2:11–13 with John 6:35, the chorus is Ps 73:26 with Song 2:16 and Hag 2:8, 2:1–4 is Matt 7:7 with Phil 4:19, and 3:1–4 is Ps 16:5 with Ps 23:1.
The chorus follows stanza 1 as the print's labelled [القرار]; the payload keeps it as its own four-line stanza, so the hymn reads stanza–chorus–stanza–stanza as printed.

3:4 לֹא יַסְפִּיק לִי זוּלָתֶךָ — the Arabic لَا يَكْفِينِي إِلَّاك is 'none but You suffices me'; the Hebrew uses שָׂפַק (to suffice, 1 Kgs 20:10) with the same negative, so the line keeps the exact claim and its exclusivity.
